title: ペルソナ2 罰

layouts.notes: The u32 at 0x800EC014 is the address of the loaded scene's text: its messages back to back, each ended by 0x1103 (32,188 bytes in the longest scene). The u32 at 0x8007CEA0 points at the window object: +0x04 is 0x80175290, +0x0C the address the game reads at, +0x14 its state (bit 0x04 while a message is up, low byte 0x44 while it waits). While the camp menu is up the cell holds 0x00FFFFFF: `when` can't be read. A message of several screens reads whole on each. A choice reads as its question's last line, then an answer a line. Read in a replay only; shops and battles not checked.

sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 609, utf16le 191 characters of prose-like text
Persona 2: Tsumi's table (same font up to 0x0A0E) and this disc's packed scene files, unpacked: every message decoded to proofread the codes from 0x0A0F; the control words counted
Headless replay from boot (docs/replay.md): the font in memory, the window's cells and the text pointer
notes: Persona 2: Tsumi's engine at other addresses: Tsumi's table, then this game's own for the glyphs from 0x0A0F. A control word 0x1Nxx takes N minus 0x11 argument words (the layout's `codes`): 0x122E colour, 0x1205 pause, 0x1208 opens a choice of that many answers and 0x1109 waits for it. 0x1120 to 0x1122 are names put in by code and read as nothing (Tsumi's table has 0x1120 as a space; `controls` wins). 0x1130 to 0x1132 are gaps: a space in the table. Partial: 43 codes the script uses are left out of the tables (in doubt or blank, 85 uses) and read as U+FFFD. The layout is for SLPS-02785 only.
